ui_select.prompt: A single heavy servo clunk followed immediately by a magnetic latch engaging. Dry industrial machinery, close-miked in a small hard room. No reverb tail, no music, no ringing, no room ambience.
ui_select.usage: Chassis change in the showroom rail. Plays under the weight-settle.

ui_hover.prompt: A very short dry electrical relay tick. Tiny, clean, almost inaudible. A single contact closing. No pitch, no ring, no reverb, no tail, no music.
ui_hover.usage: Rail tile hover, rate-limited to one play per 120 ms. Subliminal by design — if it is audible as a sound rather than felt as texture, it is too loud.

ui_panel.prompt: A soft pneumatic latch releasing on a metal access panel, followed by a short hydraulic sigh. Dry, close, industrial. No reverb, no music, no metallic ring.
ui_panel.usage: Section reveal on the campaign ladder and the FAQ.

ui_launch.prompt: A heavy industrial power contactor closing, followed by a deep generator spinning up and holding. Dry, close-miked, mechanical and electrical. No music, no melody, no reverb wash.
ui_launch.usage: Play button press, immediately before navigation to the game.
